title: Dark Conniption
html:
Dark Conniption
Skill Type:  Self Buff
Trainer:  Fighter
Number of Ranks:  10
Cost to Max:  2096517
Zap melee target with shadow damage and increases your attack speed.

Every time you strike an enemy with your melee weapon it has a chance to zap your target with Shadow Damage. This skill requires a shield to use and has a mana cost associated with activation. While active, each successful zap has an additional mana cost. Each time your target gets zapped, your Melee Attack Speed increases for a duration. Upto 9 conniption fits may stack and the overall Dark Conniption lasts for 25 seconds.

The downside is that your Defense Rating and Stun Resistance are reduced when having a conniption fit.

Cooldown: 50 Seconds
